title: Predictive Maintenance at the Edge: An Embedded Anomaly Detection Pipeline Trained with Quantum Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.40848v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This article presents a predictive-maintenance pipeline that detects anomalies in bearings from vibration signals, adapted for deployment at the edge on low-cost microcontrollers, and that uses quantum optimization in two steps of its training. The pipeline consists of a step of vibration feature extraction and a step of classification with a one-class support vector machine (OCSVM). The features are selected by minimum redundancy and maximum relevance (mRMR) with the variational quantum eigensolver (VQE), under a limit on computing time. The OCSVM is adapted for inference at the edge without floating-point operations and is trained by a variational quantum algorithm with Pauli-correlation encoding (PCE). translated_title: 边缘预测性维护：基于量子优化训练的嵌入式异常检测流水线
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种预测性维护流水线，用于从振动信号中检测轴承异常，适用于部署在低成本微控制器上的边缘设备，并在其训练的两个步骤中采用了量子优化。该流水线包括振动特征提取步骤和使用单类支持向量机（OCSVM）的分类步骤。特征通过最小冗余最大相关性（mRMR）方法结合变分量子本征求解器（VQE）在计算时间限制下进行选择。OCSVM经过改造，能够在边缘端进行无需浮点运算的推理，并通过采用泡利相关性编码（PCE）的变分量子算法进行训练。在模拟器上使用Paderborn轴承数据集进行的小规模测试中，VQE在使用Adam优化器时于36%的运行中找到了最优选择，PCE选择的支持向量优于随机选择，直到经典局部搜索使两者……
tldr: 本文提出一种可在低成本微控制器上部署的轴承异常检测边缘流水线，利用变分量子本征求解器（VQE）进行特征选择、采用泡利相关性编码（PCE）的变分量子算法训练无浮点运算的OCSVM，将量子优化与边缘智能预测性维护相结合。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an edge-deployable anomaly detection pipeline for bearing predictive maintenance that uses the variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) for feature selection and a Pauli-correlation-encoding (PCE) variational quantum algorithm to train a floating-point-free OCSVM, combining quantum optimization with edge intelligence.
